records.specification_basis: All official technical sources specify six sequential ratios. The official material explicitly places paddle-shift controls on the steering wheel. The gearbox is explicitly described as sequential. The reviewed sources describe paddle sequential operation and no upshift rev-match action; blip is not an upshift field for this evidence. The reviewed sources do not describe an upshift automatic blip action. No separate downshift throttle-lift procedure is stated; the relevant unresolved field is rev matching or automatic control. The sources do not describe a downshift torque-cut action. Alpine explicitly specifies an integrated display in the steering wheel. The reviewed sources did not establish the remaining technique and wheel fields, which stay unknown in the real-car baseline: /authentic_controls/transmission/gearbox_type, /authentic_controls/transmission/standing_start_clutch, /authentic_controls/transmission/upshift/clutch, /authentic_controls/transmission/upshift/throttle_lift, /authentic_controls/transmission/upshift/automatic_cut, /authentic_controls/transmission/downshift/clutch, /authentic_controls/transmission/downshift/manual_blip, /authentic_controls/transmission/downshift/automatic_blip, /authentic_controls/steering/wheel_rim/shape, /authentic_controls/steering/wheel_rim/shift_lights, /authentic_controls/steering/wheel_rim/open_top.
